title: Per-category variant with a hero
when: Top categories that deserve their own banner: an alternative page variant per category, assigned in the cabinet.
evidence: per-category heroes in a few of the 43 stores

steps.note: Or `collection-hero-plate`. The live text is a short caption (20 characters or less) or nothing, never the category name: the listing prints that as the H1 one line below. Text colour by the frame (dark on light photos).

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: One banner per category, kept in sync by hand. Assigning categories to the variant happens in the cabinet; a variant with nothing assigned is seen by nobody.
RichText with SEO copy after the listing belongs here, per category, never on the default variant.
The category's own description belongs in the cabinet; the banner carries the mood, the listing the name.
